description: Browse the next N days of events day by day, with no search words. `by_day` counts every match per date, and when more events match than `limit` the rows are spread evenly across the days (earliest first within each day), so each day is represented. Use it for overviews like "what's happening this week"; for search words, free-only, a town or exact from/to dates use search_events, and for one event's details get_event. Optional filters: one category or topic, an audience, and a place: `neighborhood` keeps events inside a named area (radius_km widens it past the boundary), `near` ranks events by distance from a place or "lat,lon" within radius_km. No sign-in; each client gets 30 calls a minute and 2,500 event rows an hour.

audience.description: Who the event is only for: kids, teens, seniors (older adults: senior-center programs, 55+ groups), or general (none of those). Default: no filter. Caregiver/aging talks for families and professionals are general.

biz_format.description: Kind of work event: referral_group (BNI etc.), chamber, mixer, breakfast_lunch, workshop_training, conference_expo, career_fair, ce_credits, pitch_demo, committee_meeting

changed_since.description: Only events added or changed (title, date or time, venue, link, price, sold out, status) at or after this moment: YYYY-MM-DD (local) or an ISO date-time. To follow up later, pass the previous result's changes.synced_at; changes.removed then lists events taken down since.

near.description: Events within radius_km of a place: a neighborhood, a town, a venue name, or "lat,lon". Results get distance_km, nearest first within each day. Use this for "near X"; use neighborhood for "in X". Unmapped venues are left out (counted in place.unplaced_events).

neighborhood.description: Only events in this San Francisco neighborhood (or town): Bayview, Bernal Heights, Castro, Chinatown, Excelsior, FiDi / South Beach, Glen Park, Golden Gate Park, Haight, Hayes Valley, Ingleside / Oceanview, Inner Richmond, Inner Sunset, Japantown, Lakeshore, Lincoln Park, Lone Mountain / USF, Marina, McLaren Park, Mission, Mission Bay, Nob Hill, Noe Valley, North Beach, Outer Mission, Outer Richmond, Pacific Heights, Portola, Potrero Hill, Presidio, Presidio Heights, Russian Hill, Seacliff, SoMa, Sunset / Parkside, Tenderloin, Treasure Island, Twin Peaks, Visitacion Valley, West of Twin Peaks, Western Addition. Sub-neighborhood and common names work too. Add radius_km to also take events within that distance of its centre. Events whose venue isn't mapped can't be placed and are left out; the response's place.unplaced_events counts them.

radius_km.description: Distance for near (default 1.5, max 50), or how far neighborhood reaches past its boundary (default 0)

sector.description: Industry a work event is for (only events with a work topic carry one; general networking has none): e.g. senior_care, healthcare, real_estate, finance_insurance, legal, tech

name: list_upcoming

by_day.description: Matches per date (YYYY-MM-DD), all of them, not just the rows shown

removed.description: Upcoming events taken down (cancelled, delisted or merged into another listing) since `since`, newest first, last two weeks at most

removed_count.description: Total removals when more than are listed

synced_at.description: Pass this as changed_since next time to get only what changed after this answer

tracked_since.description: When change tracking started for this city

data_generated.description: When this city's data was last published

audience.description: kids, teens or seniors when the event is only for them

changed.description: When we last saw the title, date or time, venue, link, price or status change (local ISO time); the first-seen day for older events

checked_live.description: When we last opened the original listing and found it still matches (time, venue, not cancelled); local ISO time. Absent = not checked in the last two days

city.description: Town or city within the metro

distance_km.description: With near: distance from the place

event_status.description: What a source says: postponed (no new date yet; listed on its original date), rescheduled (this is the new date), moved (to another venue; location is the new one), sold_out. Absent = scheduled as listed; cancelled events are left out

id.description: Stable 12-character id; pass it to get_event

link.description: The original listing; keep it and credit What's Up In

price.description: All-in price as the source states it, "Free", or "See tickets" when the source doesn't state the all-in total

recurring.description: weekly, biweekly or monthly when the event is one date of a series

start.description: Local start, ISO 8601, when the source gives a time

status_note.description: The source's own wording of event_status, e.g. "Moved to The Warfield"

unplaced_events.description: Events left out because their venue isn't mapped

title: List upcoming events
